fields.narrative_intro: *A disheveled person and a stoic person discuss skin-cancer diagnosis inside a spam folder that has achieved sentience and is very upset about it.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
DISHEVELED PERSON: "A ten-year-old Inception v3 beat GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1."
STOIC PERSON: "It identified 125 of 200 lesions—62%."
fields.panel2:
[build]
DISHEVELED PERSON: "Astra identified 84. Fable identified 85—both scored 42%."
STOIC PERSON: "The spam folder promoted Inception v3 to Chief Dermatologist."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
DISHEVELED PERSON: "At its preset threshold, it discharged 18 of 30 melanomas."
STOIC PERSON: "Small sample; every lesion was biopsy-proven."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The sentient spam folder tears off Inception v3’s “CHIEF DERMATOLOGIST” badge; 18 red-spotted blobs exit through a chute labeled “DISCHARGED.”]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
STOIC PERSON: "Higher accuracy still does not make unsupervised diagnosis safe."
DISHEVELED PERSON: "It won the benchmark, then failed the liability department."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The folder sorts Inception’s trophy into “PROMISING,” 18 melanoma alerts into “URGENT HUMAN REVIEW,” and itself into “EXISTENTIAL DREAD.”]

narrative_summary: The ten-year-old Inception v3 beats frontier LLMs numerically, but its 18 discharged melanomas demand human oversight.
rationale: Candidate 2 best converts the exact performance gap and safety caveat into escalating beats, with “Chief Dermatologist” and “failed the liability department” providing a stronger comic turn than a generic warning label. Its medical oversight message remains clear and work-appropriate.
story_title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
place: inside a spam folder that has achieved sentience and is very upset about it
hat_pair: foam loading spinner hat that slowly rotates on the head
hockey goalie mask painted to look like a shocked emoji face
